remarks: This legal 3-family dwelling, currently functioning as a 4-family income-producing property, is located on the west side of Stamford, CT. The property boasts an ideal location within close proximity to Leone Park, Stamford Hospital, I-95, and an array of shopping options, making it attractive for tenants and owner-occupants alike. Currently, all units are rented at significantly below-market rates, presenting an excellent opportunity for increased cash flow. Additionally, all tenants are on month-to-month leases, providing flexibility for adjustments to rental terms or occupancy. Each unit offers comfortable layouts with distinct features to suit various living arrangements. The additional unit provides extra income potential or flexibility for extended family living (buyer to perform due diligence on zoning compliance). The property also includes ample off-street parking and a detached oversized garage. With easy access to major transportation routes, local amenities, and recreational spaces, this versatile property offers a unique investment opportunity. Perfect for investors or buyers seeking rental income while living on-site.
